title: Kuri Hime Ayakashi Yobanashi Manga Ends on October 28
content: The November issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine announced on Monday that Anko Chōchin's Kuri Hime Ayakashi Yobanashi , the manga adaptation of Hyuganatsu 's novel series of the same title, will end in the magazine's next issue on October 28.
author: ANN

title: Manga Plus Adds Digimon Eggs Manga on October 2
content: The Digimon franchise announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that Shueisha 's MANGA Plus platform will add Ayumu Minato's Digimon Eggs manga as a simulpub title on October 2. The series will launch in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine on the same day.
author: ANN

title: Katsuwo Launches Manga Adaptation of Renren Ii's Ōja no Ban Kuruwase Shōgi Novels
content: Manga creator Katsuwo launched a manga adaptation of Renren Ii's Ōja no Ban Kuruwase: Net Shōgi no Teiō, Real Taikai de Chōjō o Mezasu ( Underdog Upsets the King ) light novels in the November issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G on Monday. The issue's front cover will also feature the manga.
author: ANN

title: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor Anime's English Dub Debuts on October 4
content: WWWave Corporation 's anime streaming platform OceanVeil announced on Monday that the English dub of the television anime of Okumaro 's Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I’m Gonna Click Away On The Girls!
author: ANN

title: 2 Years Ago Today, Shonen Jump’s Most Modern Manga Reached Its End, But Fans Still Aren’t Over It
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump has transformed significantly in recent years, and the end of this particular manga series two years ago, despite emerging as one of the best new manga series, proves how the magazine has started to embrace quality over quantity.
author: ComicBook

title: Titan Manga's Chiruran 3-in-1 Edition Manga Ships in January 2027
content: Titan Manga revealed on Tuesday that it will ship its English 3-in-1 omnibus edition of Eiji Hashimoto and Shinya Umemura 's Chiruran: Shinsengumi Requiem ( Chiruran: Shinsengumi Chinkon-ka ) manga on January 26, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Ankoku Delta's Alpa Launches New Slap Shot Girls Hockey Manga
content: Alpa launched a new series titled Slap Shot Girls on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform on Tuesday. MANGA Plus began releasing it in English at the same time on Monday The story follows Kurumi Kobashiri, who moves to Hokkaido after middle school due to her parents' circumstances.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man Creator Is Teasing a New Manga That Promises to Explore His Most Ambitious Vision
content: Tatsuki Fujimoto has emerged as one of the most renowned modern manga creators, proving himself through numerous one-shots and his magnum opus, Chainsaw Man . The manga series came to an end earlier this year, albeit with a rushed ending that fans are still not over, but the manga remains one of the best there is.
author: ComicBook
